$comment: Shared compiler options for the packages/* workspaces.
These MUST stay in step with apps/rough-cut/tsconfig.json and
apps/wallet/tsconfig.json. A shared package is consumed as raw TypeScript,
so it is compiled by each consuming app under THAT app's tsconfig. If this
base were looser than an app's config, a package would typecheck here and
fail there, which is worse than not checking it at all.
`target` is the one that has already bitten: it is ES2017, below ES2020,
which is why BigInt cannot be used inside a shared package even though the
package's own tests would run fine on modern Node.
